#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is due to the `BASE_URL` constant in `src/notifications/templates.ts` defaulting to `http://localhost:3000` if the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable is not set. This causes password reset links in emails to incorrectly use localhost when the deployment environment does not set this variable. The fix likely involves ensuring `PUBLIC_URL` is correctly set in the production environment or modifying the code to properly determine the base URL.
